rationale: Price gapped down ~3.4% and is sitting near the session low (19th percentile of today's range) with the last candle showing a modest bounce off $33.78, but the 9-EMA at $34.47 is well above current price and acting as resistance, suggesting the downtrend is intact. The spread is wide at 23.6 bps and the stock is highly volatile (ATR ~$0.18 on 5m bars relative to a ~$34 price), making clean risk definition difficult. With no clear structural support level confirmed and price still in early price discovery after a large gap, the risk/reward for either direction lacks sufficient conviction to justify adding exposure alongside the existing working order.
